pages.title: Spice Rack
pages.text: Holds up to 8 stacks of spices, displays them in the world in a neat looking way, and makes them available to nearby $(l:mechanics/spice_grinder)Spice Grinders$(). Depending on whether it was placed against the ceiling, floor or a wall, it will have one of three models. The rendering distance can be changed in the client config.
Craft it from any of the 11 base wood types. Modded wood types result in Oak.
